requirementSections.heading: Prescribed Courses

rules.commentRaw: 3 credits of study in a second language, while a PSU student, at the 3 (third-semester) level or higher
6 credits (typically two courses) of study in courses approved to meet the International Cultures requirement (IL) of General Education
1-3 credits and/or at least six weeks of approved study or workabroad, consisting of course work, internship, research, etc.
